game.title: Burnout Paradise Remastered
game.blurb: Open-world arcade racing game, the remaster of 2008's Burnout Paradise, from Criterion Games (RAWG also lists Electronic Arts and Stellar Entertainment), released 2018-03-16. RAWG average playtime: 2 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Licences and Events
chapters.summary: Climbing from the D class licence to the Burnout Elite licence through races, Burning Routes, Marked Man, Road Rage and Stunt Run events.

chapters.title: Road Rules and Showtime
chapters.summary: Setting Time and Showtime Road Rules on every road, and big Showtime multipliers.

chapters.title: Billboards, Smashes, Superjumps and Car Parks
chapters.summary: Finding every billboard, smash, superjump, car park, drive-thru and event in Paradise City.

chapters.title: Stunts, Boosts and Takedowns
chapters.summary: Flatspins, barrel rolls, boost chains, power parking, takedown rampages and repairs.

chapters.title: Online Races, Challenges and Party Games
chapters.summary: Online races and events, rivals, online Freeburn challenges, Party games and Cops and Robbers.

chapters.title: Big Surf Island
chapters.summary: The island's smashes, billboards, events, the Crash TV ski jump and its Freeburn challenges.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2018 remaster, with its own Steam app 1238080 ("Burnout™ Paradise Remastered"); RAWG lists the 2008 original separately (burnout-paradise). StrategyWiki has only "Burnout Paradise" (completion stage 0); only its Controls and Table of Contents subpages are written, and Walkthrough, Gameplay and Achievements and trophies are linked but not written, so nothing was used. burnout.fandom.com has "Burnout Paradise" with about 73 linked pages (including "Big Surf Island (Location)", used only for the chapter name); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 56 Steam achievements is hidden. The island achievements only say "Island" in their descriptions; the Big Surf Island name comes from the Fandom page list. "Criterion Elite" (licence plus every event, discoverable and Road Rule) sits with the licences.
